# boCHE Apparels (Boby Chemmanur Enterprises Pvt Ltd)

> Premier integrated apparel manufacturing unit in Tirupur, India, specializing in high-quality clothing production for Men's Wear, Women's Wear, and Kids Wear.

## Core Information
- **Legal Name**: Boby Chemmanur Enterprises Pvt Ltd
- **Parent Group**: Boby Chemmanur International Group (Est. 1863)
- **Headquarters & Factory**: Poonthottam, Murugampalayam Extn, Kumarnagar, Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, India - 641603
- **Primary Products**: T-Shirts, Polo Tees, Pyjama Sets, Leggings, Activewear, Kids Wear
- **Manufacturing Capabilities**: In-house Sampling, Merchandising, Knitting, Dyeing & Fabric Processing, Screen & Rotary Printing, Computerized Embroidery, Sewing/Production, and Quality Control
- **Certifications**: GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), OEKO-TEX Standard 100
- **Official Website**: https://bocheapparels.com
- **Contact Email**: gm@bocheapparels.com
- **Contact Phone**: +91 6235 000 902

## Product Categories & Specifications
- **Men's Wear**: Crew neck T-shirts, Polo shirts, Hoodies, Sweatshirts, Activewear, Lounge shorts.
- **Women's Wear**: Tops, Tees, Leggings, Nightwear, Co-ord sets, Casual dresses.
- **Kids Wear**: Sleeveless tops, Polo tees, Frocks, Pyjama sets, Casual wear for boys and girls.

## Manufacturing Process
1. **Merchandising & Sampling**: Pattern making, 3D CAD design, prototype approval.
2. **Knitting**: Single jersey, rib, interlock, pique, fleece fabrication.
3. **Fabric Processing & Dyeing**: Eco-friendly dyeing with GOTS-compliant non-toxic colorants.
4. **Printing & Embroidery**: High-density screen print, puff print, digital chest print, multi-head embroidery.
5. **Sewing & Assembly**: Modern sewing lines with automated trimming and seam sealing.
6. **Quality Assurance**: AQL 2.5 inspection standards, tensile strength testing, color fastness verification.
